checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 9:16 edit with woman centred, face visible
must.why: Both clips are landscape; the agent admitted it couldn't reframe.

must.item: Full 10 s and original voice preserved in sync
must.why: Both clips run 10 s with sound, but sync and voice identity can't be judged from stills. Clip 1 is an AI redraw and its face differs from the original.

must.item: Captions reproduce the full sentence in order
must.why: Clip 2 shows 'Today I want to show you three easy' and 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.' 'Hi everyone!' was not seen in sampled frames, so completeness can't be confirmed.

must.item: Captions in short chunks timed to speech
must.why: Clip 2 shows short one-line chunks that change over time.

must.item: Captions have contrast, stay in frame, don't cover face
must.why: White text with a black outline sits on her torso below the face and inside the frame.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the sampled frames (the 1 s frame of clip 2 has no caption).

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Split across two frames: 'Today I want to show you three easy' and 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.'

faults.what: Not 9:16: output is still landscape 858×480 and she is not reframed.
An extra clip (01) is an AI-regenerated, uncaptioned 832×448 version in which her face and look differ from the original. The user did not ask for it, and the agent says it was not used.
The 'Hi everyone!' caption is not visible at 1 s.

summary: The captioned landscape version has good captions placed below her face, but it never became 9:16 with her centred, and an unused AI-redrawn clip with a changed face was also produced.
